note: Sentence-to-source map for /about/facts/ (src/content/pages/about/facts.mdx). Every sentence of the page body is listed, with the repository file it comes from and a locator that appears in that file; tests/unit/wp-41/facts.test.ts fails when a sentence is missing from this list or a locator is not found. The page makes no statistic and cites no outside source: it restates what the rest of the site already says, so every source is first-party. Also recorded: the AI crawler names in robots.txt (src/lib/seo.ts) are recalled from the vendors' published documentation, not fetched in this session; see the handoff for the vendor page to check for each family.

sentences.sentence: World Enterprise is a long-horizon business incubation and consulting firm, run by World Enterprise Group Incorporated.
sentences.locator: World Enterprise is a long-horizon business incubation and consulting firm, run by World Enterprise Group Incorporated.

sentences.sentence: WE steers a dedicated, fully remote team that builds a software-enabled company with its founder, for as long as the work is useful.
sentences.locator: WE steers a dedicated, fully remote team that builds a software-enabled company with its founder, for as long as the work is useful.

sentences.sentence: The work is fully remote.
sentences.locator: It means WE works fully online.

sentences.sentence: There are no physical offices.
sentences.locator: There are no physical offices.

sentences.sentence: WE makes no promise of funding.
sentences.locator: WE makes no promise of funding.

sentences.sentence: WE helps founders prepare evidence for investors.
sentences.locator: WE helps founders prepare evidence for investors.

sentences.sentence: It does not predict or arrange an investment, and it cannot say that anyone will invest.
sentences.locator: It does not predict or arrange an investment, and it cannot say that anyone will invest.

sentences.sentence: WE is a long-horizon business incubation and consulting firm.
sentences.locator: WE is a long-horizon business incubation and consulting firm.

sentences.sentence: It builds with your company through a dedicated team that WE steers, for as long as the work is useful.
sentences.locator: It builds with your company through a dedicated team that WE steers, for as long as the work is useful.

sentences.sentence: The program does not give legal, tax or accounting advice, and it does not keep your books or file your taxes.
sentences.locator: It does not give legal, tax or accounting advice, and it does not keep your books or file your taxes.

sentences.sentence: WE does not stand in for a company's counsel or accountants.
sentences.locator: It does not stand in for them and does not give legal or financial advice.

sentences.sentence: There are no logo walls, no quotes from customers and no performance figures on this site.
sentences.locator: There are no logo walls, no quotes from customers and no performance figures on this site.

sentences.sentence: WE offers seven service lines, A to G, and every one of them states what it does not cover.
sentences.locator: doesNotCover:

sentences.locator: title: Brand and Identity

sentences.sentence: Seats can be scaled up or down by notice.
sentences.locator: Seats can be scaled up or down by notice.

sentences.sentence: The notice mechanics are set out in the written agreement.
sentences.locator: The notice mechanics are set out in the written agreement.

sentences.sentence: Spark, depth Core: An idea or a prototype before revenue, with one or two founders and no institutional capital yet.
sentences.locator: An idea or a prototype before revenue, with one or two founders and no institutional capital yet.

sentences.sentence: Launch, depth Standard: A first product in build or first pilots under way, at the pre-seed stage.
sentences.locator: A first product in build or first pilots under way, at the pre-seed stage.

sentences.sentence: Accelerate, depth Extended: A working product with early customer evidence, preparing a seed round or an equivalent.
sentences.locator: A working product with early customer evidence, preparing a seed round or an equivalent.

sentences.sentence: Studio, depth Embedded: A company with several products, or in a regulated or capital-intensive field, that needs an embedded WE team.
sentences.locator: A company with several products, or in a regulated or capital-intensive field, that needs an embedded WE team.

sentences.sentence: The fee does not depend on whether any investment closes.
sentences.locator: The fee does not depend on whether any investment closes.

sentences.sentence: Introductions are a flat-fee service.
sentences.locator: Introductions are a flat-fee service.

sentences.sentence: WE is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser, takes no fee or stake tied to any investment, and cannot promise a meeting or funding.
sentences.locator: WE is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser, takes no fee or stake tied to any investment, and cannot promise a meeting or funding.

sentences.sentence: Use the application form on the Apply page.
sentences.locator: Use the application form on the Apply page.

sentences.sentence: Ask WE a question or apply when you are ready.
sentences.locator: Ask WE a question or apply when you are ready.

sentences.sentence: The contact page also takes a request for the current seat rate or a report of something that needs correcting.
sentences.locator: Ask a question, request the current seat rate, or tell WE about something that needs correcting.
